retrievalProfile.description: A radial collage featuring a central circular photo wheel surrounded by a repeating ring of a single subject, utilizing heavy 1970s display typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition centered on a large circular graphic divided into wedge-shaped photographic segments. This central wheel is ringed by eight identical portraits of a man in a yellow jacket, rotated to form a continuous outer circle. The background is dark, with bold, high-contrast serif typography placed in the corners.
coreVisualRelationships: Radial symmetry between the outer portrait ring and inner photo wheel
High contrast between the dark background and vibrant yellow clothing
Concentric circular framing elements separating the inner and outer layers
Inverted typographic blocks in opposite corners creating diagonal balance
coreInvariants: Eight-fold radial repetition of the primary subject
Wedge-shaped photographic divisions within a central circle

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is repeated in a large ring occupying 70% of the frame, with a multi-scene collage at the absolute center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central point of the circular collage where all wedge lines converge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular motion following the portrait ring, then inward to the detailed collage segments.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black/dark brown space in the four corners and between the portrait heads.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal/black background providing a void for the graphics.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright mustard yellow in the subject's clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Teal and tan concentric rings bordering the central circle.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellow and teal against a low-value, desaturated background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Tightly kerned 'CH' and 'AN' pairs to create a block-like texture
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying weights and sizes for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and high contrast of 70s soul typography.
Provides the necessary extreme contrast and sharp serifs.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a radial collage on a black background. The center is a circle divided into 8-10 photographic wedges showing various lifestyle scenes. Surround this circle with 8 identical portraits of a man in a yellow jacket, rotated 45 degrees each to form a ring.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, high-contrast serif text in the top-left corner. Duplicate and rotate this text block 180 degrees in the bottom-right corner.

verificationChecks: Are there exactly 8 repeating portraits in the outer ring?
Is the central circle divided into wedge-shaped photos?
Is the bottom-right text block inverted?

adjustableVariables: Number of wedges in the central circle
Subject of the repeating portrait ring

avoid: Asymmetrical placement of the main ring

postGenerationChecks: Check for 180-degree rotation of bottom text
Ensure yellow jacket color is consistent across all 8 portraits
Verify the teal and tan rings are perfectly circular
Confirm the background is a solid dark tone
recipe.reuseFormula: Radial portrait ring + Wedge-collage center + Inverted corner typography = 70s Soul Aesthetic
